name: flexsoc-rtl-explorer
description: Slang-backed hierarchical SystemVerilog schematic viewer for VS Code and Cursor

flexsoc.rtlExplorer.python.description: Python executable in the same environment as the RTL project (WSL/SSH supported).

flexsoc.rtlExplorer.repository.description: Absolute path to the FlexSoC checkout containing scripts/rtl_viewer.py. Empty: use workspace root.

flexsoc.rtlExplorer.filelists.description: Slang -F filelists relative to the RTL workspace. Used instead of selecting individual sources.

flexsoc.rtlExplorer.includes.description: Slang include directories relative to the RTL workspace.
